column.name: actual_capacity_kw
column.formula: CASE WHEN ua.asset_level = 'Site' AND NOT sc.Capacity IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(sc.Capacity AS TEXT)) <> '' THEN CAST(REPLACE(CAST(sc.Capacity AS TEXT), ',', '.') AS DECIMAL) ELSE NULL END

column.name: tariff
column.formula: CASE WHEN ua.asset_level = 'Site' AND NOT sc.Tariff IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(sc.Tariff AS TEXT)) <> '' THEN CAST(REPLACE(CAST(sc.Tariff AS TEXT), ',', '.') AS DECIMAL) ELSE NULL END

column.name: site_order
column.formula: CASE WHEN ua.asset_level = 'Site' AND NOT sc.SiteOrder IS NULL THEN CAST(sc.SiteOrder AS INT) ELSE NULL END

column.name: calculation_start_date
column.formula: CASE WHEN ua.asset_level = 'Site' AND NOT sc.CalculationStartDate IS NULL AND TRIM(CAST(sc.CalculationStartDate AS TEXT)) <> '' THEN CASE WHEN CAST(sc.CalculationStartDate AS TEXT) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' THEN TO_DATE(CAST(sc.CalculationStartDate AS TEXT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHEN CAST(sc.CalculationStartDate AS TEXT) ~ '^\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}' THEN TO_DATE(CAST(sc.CalculationStartDate AS TEXT), 'FMMM/FMDD/YYYY') ELSE CAST(sc.CalculationStartDate AS DATE) END ELSE NULL END

column.name: total_inverters
column.formula: CASE WHEN ua.asset_level = 'Site' AND NOT sc.TotalInverters IS NULL THEN CAST(sc.TotalInverters AS INT) ELSE NULL END

column.name: week_of_month
column.formula: CASE WHEN week_of_month = 6 AND week6_day_count = 1 THEN 5 ELSE week_of_month END

column.name: season
column.formula: CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_key) BETWEEN 4 AND 9 THEN 'Dry Season (Kemarau)' ELSE 'Wet Season (Hujan)' END

column.name: day_type
column.formula: CASE WHEN iso_dow IN (6, 7) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END

column.name: mit_irradiance_source
column.formula: mit_irradiance_source /* Track which source was used for MIT: 'GHI', 'POA', or 'GHI_FALLBACK' */

column.name: energy_kpi_daily_mwh
column.formula: CASE WHEN mt.energy_target_monthly_mwh > 0 AND NOT mkpi.energy_kpi_mwh IS NULL THEN mkpi.energy_kpi_mwh * (sd.energy_target_mwh / mt.energy_target_monthly_mwh) ELSE NULL END

column.name: energy_a_kpi_daily_mwh
column.formula: CASE WHEN ms.energy_simulation_monthly_mwh > 0 AND NOT mkpi.energy_kpi_mwh IS NULL THEN sd.energy_target_mwh * (mkpi.energy_kpi_mwh / ms.energy_simulation_monthly_mwh) ELSE NULL END

column.name: energy_kpi_gap_ratio
column.formula: CASE WHEN mt.energy_target_mwh IS NULL OR mt.energy_target_mwh = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((CAST(COALESCE(kc.energy_kpi_mwh, kn.energy_kpi_mwh) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(mt.energy_target_mwh AS DECIMAL)), 6) END

column.name: is_issue_date
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT id.issue_date IS NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END

column.name: energy_adjusted
column.formula: CAST(COALESCE(energy_adj.energy_adjusted_value /* Priority 1: Manual adjustment from seed file */, sm.daily_energy_mwh /* Priority 2: Default: Use actual energy */) AS DECIMAL(18, 6))

column.name: ghi_adjusted
column.formula: CAST(COALESCE(ghi_manual.ghi_adjusted_value /* Priority 1: Manual adjustment from seed file (e.g., calculated from POA ratio) */, ghi_adj.ghi_adjusted_value /* Priority 2: Adjusted GHI from sensor mapping if available */, sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2 /* Priority 3: Default: Use actual GHI */) AS DECIMAL(18, 6))

column.name: pr_ghi_actual
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(ghi_manual.ghi_adjusted_value, ghi_adj.ghi_adjusted_value, sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2) IS NULL AND COALESCE(ghi_manual.ghi_adjusted_value, ghi_adj.ghi_adjusted_value, sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2) >= 0.1 /* Minimum threshold to prevent overflow */ AND NOT sm.daily_energy_mwh IS NULL AND sm.daily_energy_mwh >= 0.01 /* Minimum energy threshold */ AND NOT da.actual_capacity_kw IS NULL AND da.actual_capacity_kw > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST(((sm.daily_energy_mwh * 1000.0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ghi_manual.ghi_adjusted_value, ghi_adj.ghi_adjusted_value, sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2), 0) / NULLIF(da.actual_capacity_kw, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 10.0 /* Cap at 10.0 (1000%) to prevent overflow from data errors while still capturing anomalies */) ELSE NULL END

column.name: pr_adjusted
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT COALESCE(ghi_manual.ghi_adjusted_value /* Priority 1: Manual adjustment */, ghi_adj.ghi_adjusted_value /* Priority 2: Sensor mapping */, sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2 /* Priority 3: Actual GHI */) IS NULL AND COALESCE(ghi_manual.ghi_adjusted_value, ghi_adj.ghi_adjusted_value, sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2) >= 0.1 /* Minimum threshold to prevent overflow */ AND NOT COALESCE(energy_adj.energy_adjusted_value /* Priority 1: Manual energy adjustment */, sm.daily_energy_mwh /* Priority 2: Actual energy */) IS NULL AND COALESCE(energy_adj.energy_adjusted_value, sm.daily_energy_mwh) >= 0.01 /* Minimum energy threshold */ AND NOT da.actual_capacity_kw IS NULL AND da.actual_capacity_kw > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST(((COALESCE(energy_adj.energy_adjusted_value, sm.daily_energy_mwh) * 1000.0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ghi_manual.ghi_adjusted_value, ghi_adj.ghi_adjusted_value, sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2), 0) / NULLIF(da.actual_capacity_kw, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 10.0 /* Cap at 10.0 (1000%) to prevent overflow from data errors while still capturing anomalies */) ELSE NULL END

column.name: pr_poa_actual
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT sm.daily_poa_weighted_kwh_m2 IS NULL AND sm.daily_poa_weighted_kwh_m2 >= 0.1 /* Minimum threshold to prevent overflow */ AND NOT sm.daily_energy_mwh IS NULL AND sm.daily_energy_mwh >= 0.01 /* Minimum energy threshold */ AND NOT da.actual_capacity_kw IS NULL AND da.actual_capacity_kw > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST(((sm.daily_energy_mwh * 1000.0) / NULLIF(sm.daily_poa_weighted_kwh_m2, 0) / NULLIF(da.actual_capacity_kw, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 2.0 /* Cap at 2.0 (200%) to prevent overflow from data errors */) ELSE NULL END

column.name: energy_actual_vs_target_pct
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT t.energy_target_mwh IS NULL AND t.energy_target_mwh > 0 AND NOT sm.daily_energy_mwh IS NULL THEN CAST((sm.daily_energy_mwh / NULLIF(t.energy_target_mwh, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: ghi_actual_vs_target_pct
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT t.ghi IS NULL AND t.ghi > 0 AND NOT sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2 IS NULL THEN CAST((sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2 / NULLIF(t.ghi, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: poa_actual_vs_target_pct
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT t.poa IS NULL AND t.poa > 0 AND NOT sm.daily_poa_weighted_kwh_m2 IS NULL THEN CAST((sm.daily_poa_weighted_kwh_m2 / NULLIF(t.poa, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: energy_vs_ghi_variance_pct
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT t.energy_target_mwh IS NULL AND t.energy_target_mwh > 0 AND NOT t.ghi IS NULL AND t.ghi > 0 AND NOT sm.daily_energy_mwh IS NULL AND NOT sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2 IS NULL THEN CAST(((sm.daily_energy_mwh / NULLIF(t.energy_target_mwh, 0)) - (sm.daily_ghi_kwh_m2 / NULLIF(t.ghi, 0))) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: energy_kpi_daily_mwh
column.formula: CASE WHEN mt_kpi.energy_target_monthly_mwh > 0 AND NOT mkpi.energy_kpi_mwh IS NULL AND NOT t.energy_target_mwh IS NULL THEN CAST(mkpi.energy_kpi_mwh * (t.energy_target_mwh / mt_kpi.energy_target_monthly_mwh) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: energy_a_kpi_daily_mwh
column.formula: CASE WHEN ms_kpi.energy_simulation_monthly_mwh > 0 AND NOT mkpi.energy_kpi_mwh IS NULL AND NOT t.energy_target_mwh IS NULL THEN CAST(t.energy_target_mwh * (mkpi.energy_kpi_mwh / ms_kpi.energy_simulation_monthly_mwh) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: availability_percent
column.formula: CASE WHEN (monthly_power_available_hours + monthly_unavailability_hours) > 0 THEN CAST((monthly_power_available_hours / NULLIF(monthly_power_available_hours + monthly_unavailability_hours, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: pr_ghi_actual
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT monthly_ghi_kwh_m2 IS NULL AND monthly_ghi_kwh_m2 >= 0.1 /* Minimum threshold */ AND NOT monthly_energy_mwh IS NULL AND monthly_energy_mwh >= 0.01 /* Minimum energy threshold */ AND NOT actual_capacity_kw IS NULL AND actual_capacity_kw > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST(((monthly_energy_mwh * 1000.0) / NULLIF(monthly_ghi_kwh_m2, 0) / NULLIF(actual_capacity_kw, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 10.0 /* Cap at 10.0 to prevent overflow */) ELSE NULL END

column.name: pr_poa_actual
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT monthly_poa_weighted_kwh_m2 IS NULL AND monthly_poa_weighted_kwh_m2 >= 0.1 /* Minimum threshold */ AND NOT monthly_energy_mwh IS NULL AND monthly_energy_mwh >= 0.01 /* Minimum energy threshold */ AND NOT actual_capacity_kw IS NULL AND actual_capacity_kw > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST(((monthly_energy_mwh * 1000.0) / NULLIF(monthly_poa_weighted_kwh_m2, 0) / NULLIF(actual_capacity_kw, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 2.0 /* Cap at 2.0 to prevent overflow */) ELSE NULL END

column.name: energy_actual_vs_target_pct
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT monthly_energy_target_mwh IS NULL AND monthly_energy_target_mwh > 0 AND NOT monthly_energy_mwh IS NULL THEN CAST((monthly_energy_mwh / NULLIF(monthly_energy_target_mwh, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: ghi_actual_vs_target_pct
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT monthly_ghi_target IS NULL AND monthly_ghi_target > 0 AND NOT monthly_ghi_kwh_m2 IS NULL THEN CAST((monthly_ghi_kwh_m2 / NULLIF(monthly_ghi_target, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: poa_actual_vs_target_pct
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT monthly_poa_target IS NULL AND monthly_poa_target > 0 AND NOT monthly_poa_weighted_kwh_m2 IS NULL THEN CAST((monthly_poa_weighted_kwh_m2 / NULLIF(monthly_poa_target, 0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: energy_vs_ghi_variance_pct
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT monthly_energy_target_mwh IS NULL AND monthly_energy_target_mwh > 0 AND NOT monthly_ghi_target IS NULL AND monthly_ghi_target > 0 AND NOT monthly_energy_mwh IS NULL AND NOT monthly_ghi_kwh_m2 IS NULL THEN CAST(((monthly_energy_mwh / NULLIF(monthly_energy_target_mwh, 0)) - (monthly_ghi_kwh_m2 / NULLIF(monthly_ghi_target, 0))) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) ELSE NULL END

column.name: pr_ghi_string
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT daily_ghi_kwh_m2 IS NULL AND daily_ghi_kwh_m2 >= 0.1 AND NOT daily_energy_kwh IS NULL AND daily_energy_kwh >= 0.01 AND NOT string_dc_capacity_kw_stc IS NULL AND string_dc_capacity_kw_stc > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST((daily_energy_kwh / 1000.0) / NULLIF(daily_ghi_kwh_m2 * string_dc_capacity_kw_stc, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 10.0) ELSE NULL END

column.name: pr_poa_string
column.formula: CASE WHEN NOT daily_poa_kwh_m2 IS NULL AND daily_poa_kwh_m2 >= 0.1 AND NOT daily_energy_kwh IS NULL AND daily_energy_kwh >= 0.01 AND NOT string_dc_capacity_kw_stc IS NULL AND string_dc_capacity_kw_stc > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST((daily_energy_kwh / 1000.0) / NULLIF(daily_poa_kwh_m2 * string_dc_capacity_kw_stc, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 10.0) ELSE NULL END

column.name: pr_ghi_string
column.formula: CASE WHEN monthly_ghi_kwh_m2 > 0 AND monthly_energy_kwh > 0 AND string_dc_capacity_kw_stc > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST((monthly_energy_kwh / 1000.0) / NULLIF(monthly_ghi_kwh_m2 * string_dc_capacity_kw_stc, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 10.0) ELSE NULL END

column.name: pr_poa_string
column.formula: CASE WHEN monthly_poa_kwh_m2 > 0 AND monthly_energy_kwh > 0 AND string_dc_capacity_kw_stc > 0 THEN LEAST(CAST((monthly_energy_kwh / 1000.0) / NULLIF(monthly_poa_kwh_m2 * string_dc_capacity_kw_stc, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)), 10.0) ELSE NULL END

column.name: days_open
column.formula: CAST((CURRENT_DATE - w.log_date) /* Berapa lama issue berjalan (hari sejak log_date) — untuk set prioritas decision */ AS INT)

column.name: is_open
column.formula: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(w.status, ''))) IN ('OPEN', 'IN PROGRESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

column.name: date_key
column.formula: dd.date_key /* Week/month/year dari dim_date_generated (algoritma sama dengan mart lain) */

column.name: device_category
column.formula: CASE WHEN dev_type_id = 1 THEN 'Inverter' WHEN dev_type_id = 17 THEN 'Meter' WHEN dev_type_id = 10 THEN 'Meteo Station' ELSE 'Unknown' END

column.name: metric_value
column.formula: CASE WHEN JSONB_TYPEOF(metric_value) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN (metric_value #>> '{}') IN ('nan', '-nan', 'infinity', '-infinity', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') THEN NULL ELSE CAST((metric_value #>> '{}') AS DECIMAL) END WHEN JSONB_TYPEOF(metric_value) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN CAST(metric_value AS TEXT) IN ('nan', '-nan', 'infinity', '-infinity', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') THEN NULL ELSE CAST(metric_value AS DECIMAL) END ELSE NULL END

column.name: device_category
column.formula: CASE WHEN device_type = 1 THEN 'Inverter' WHEN device_type = 7 THEN 'Meter' WHEN device_type = 5 THEN 'Meteo Station' ELSE 'Unknown' END

column.name: metric_value
column.formula: CASE WHEN JSONB_TYPEOF(metric_value) = 'string' THEN CASE WHEN (metric_value #>> '{}') IN ('nan', '-nan', 'infinity', '-infinity', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') THEN NULL ELSE CAST((metric_value #>> '{}') AS DECIMAL) END WHEN JSONB_TYPEOF(metric_value) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN CAST(metric_value AS TEXT) IN ('nan', '-nan', 'infinity', '-infinity', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') THEN NULL ELSE CAST(metric_value AS DECIMAL) END ELSE NULL END
